entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. Order 774-B2.
I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up that order... Okay, I see an order for the Trailblazer Helmet. Is that correct?
Alright. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
The color is hideous. It's not what it looked like online. I want to return it.
I understand. Getting the right color is important. So it's not an issue with the fit or its safety features, just the appearance?
I wouldn't know. The box is still unopened. I saw the helmet through the little plastic window and knew it was wrong.
Okay, thank you for clarifying that. Let me just check the return eligibility for this item. I see it was delivered 49 days ago.
And you are well within the return window. Our standard policy allows for returns within 90 days. I can go ahead and approve this for you right now.
I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. You should see it in the next few minutes. Just print that out and attach it to the box.
Whatever. Just make sure it gets there.
It has been sent. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
